data.narrative:
Precision AI is a Series A autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, which includes 8 private peers (Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro among them) and no public comparables. The target has raised $20M to date.

The Peer-Median method was inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers meeting valuation-tier filters within the narrow segment; a broader sector median would lack precision. Stage-Progression analysis proved the primary viable approach, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to Series B transitions against the $20M total raised proxy, yielding $40M.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $34M (low) to $46M (high), with a median of $40M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single applicable method rather than cross-confirmation. Key uncertainties include the absence of granular same-stage peer data to validate the 2.0x progression assumption and incomplete visibility into Precision AI's burn, runway, and technical differentiation relative to the broader autonomous sector. A fuller valuation would require either access to recent Series A rounds within Drones & Autonomous or market-rate data on comparable funding events. Current stage duration and momentum would materially influence whether the company approaches the range low or high.
